game: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: The Movie
toolchain: Custom (Python Z80 static recompiler + C/SDL2 runtime)
approach: Static ahead-of-time translation of the Game Gear Z80 code to C, one function per entry point, with cycle-exact scheduling that keeps it bit-identical to a reference interpreter; entry points from bank-aware static tracing plus interpreter coverage playthroughs, with zero interpreter fallback
notes: Full playthroughs to the ending on Windows with no interpreter fallback. The recompiled code matches a reference Z80 interpreter (zexdoc/zexall 67/67) bit for bit: RAM, VRAM, palette and every frame, compared each frame across 400,000+ frames of scripted play. Runtime: Game Gear VDP (Mode 4, line interrupts, 160x144 viewport), SN76489 PSG with GG stereo, Sega mapper. Features: 10 save-state slots that replay frame-exact, LCD and CRT filters, fast-forward, infinite-health toggle, keyboard and controller. Release builds are ROM-less; the user supplies the ROM (CRC32 B47C19E5).
